tonight.headline: Love says he isn't worried — Thursday's padded practice is the test
body: Bad news first: Jordan Love (back) and Justin Jefferson (ankle) are both still limited — Wednesday is the only report out, and Thursday's comes this afternoon. Love called it 'a sore back from the game' and, asked if he was worried about Sunday, said 'No, no' (Packers Wire 22 Oct). Jefferson: 'feeling better and better every single day' (AP via JOX 22 Oct). Neither has a backup who can execute at his inactive check, so both decisions still wait for Friday.
Overnight, nothing on the roster changed. ESPN projects 130.8 to JuiceJam's 105.5 and gives you 63%. The lineup as set is the projection lineup. Nothing to fire today.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Love's back flares in Thursday's padded practice and he is a surprise inactive at 12:55 Sunday with no quarterback added — a zero at QB is roughly 20 points of a 25-point projected margin.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Love full on Thursday or Friday with no game designation — then the Stafford card never fires and the margin is the projection's.

case.label: The player
case.body: Love limited Wednesday with a back injury in a walk-through estimate (Packers.com, NBC/PFT 21 Oct). Overnight he called it 'a sore back from the game' and said 'No, no' when asked if he was worried about Sunday (Packers Wire 22 Oct 00:45Z); Packernet (22 Oct) names Thursday's padded practice as the next checkpoint. ESPN's 19.8 has not moved.

case.label: The hole
case.body: The lineup tool names Josh Allen as Love's fallback — Buffalo are on bye. There is no live quarterback on this roster. If Love is inactive at 12:55 Sunday, the slot scores zero.

case.label: Why Stafford
case.body: Stafford (18.8) is now a plain free agent in this file — no claim — and kicks off at 14:25 with Love, so he can still be swapped in after Green Bay's 12:55 inactives. He is not on the Rams' Wednesday report (Raiders.com 21 Oct). Rodgers (19.7, free) plays in Paris at 07:30 and is not on Pittsburgh's report — only worth it if Love is already ruled out on Friday.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Kamara (62.7% rostered — a deliberate disagreement with the market): limited Wednesday with the back again, as he was the week before New York (Steelers Depot 21 Oct); Kendre Miller took 20 carries in Week 6 after Kamara's brief first-half scare (SI 21 Oct), and New Orleans are on bye in Week 8. He would not start in either week.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Friday's Packers report: any designation for Love after less than a full Friday practice → add Stafford, drop Kamara, before Sunday 07:30. Love OUT → add Rodgers instead and start him. Love full and undesignated → do nothing.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The add is made and Love plays the whole game — then it cost Kamara for nothing; or Stafford is added, started, and Love would have outscored him (archive).

case.label: The player
case.body: Jefferson limited Wednesday with the ankle (Vikings.com 21 Oct) — the same injury that cost him Week 3 and kept him limited before Week 5, when he played. Addison and Hockenson were full. Thursday morning: Jefferson says the ankle is 'feeling better and better every single day' (AP via JOX 22 Oct); Kyler Murray starts at quarterback.

case.label: The timing
case.body: Minnesota kick off at 11:00; inactives at 09:30. Metcalf plays the Saints in Paris at 07:30 and locks then; Diggs and Tuten are on bye. After 07:30 there is no receiver on this bench who can replace him.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Friday's Vikings report lists Jefferson doubtful or out → swap Metcalf in before Sunday 07:30. Questionable after a limited Friday → keep Jefferson: 18.6 against 14.9 is a 3.7 gap, and he played through the same tag in Week 5.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The swap is made and Jefferson plays and outscores Metcalf — or Jefferson is kept on a questionable tag and is inactive.

whatWentWrong.title: Three bye players on the bench left two starters without a Sunday fallback
whatWentWrong.lead: Allen, Tuten and Diggs are all on bye; Love's backup is Allen and Jefferson's is a 07:30 kickoff.

case.label: What happened
case.body: This morning's waiver run brought Diggs (bye) for McLaurin and Metcalf for Allgeier. That left Kamara and Metcalf as the only playable bench — both in the 07:30 Paris game. By Wednesday afternoon Love (back) and Jefferson (ankle) were both on their teams' reports.

case.label: What it leaves
case.body: Neither printed contingency can execute at its inactive check. Both cards above move the decision to Friday's reports, and the QB card spends Kamara, the one bench body who is idle in Week 8 anyway.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Love and Jefferson both practise fully by Friday with no designation — then the gap never mattered this week.

whatWentWrong.sources: ESPN activity log · Packers.com 21 Oct · Vikings.com 21 Oct

whatWentWrong.title: Week 6 was won with 11.0 left on the bench
whatWentWrong.lead: Kamara's 14.9 sat behind Allgeier's 5.8 and Love's 20.2 behind Allen's 18.3 — both projection calls, neither an override.

case.label: The numbers
case.body: 122.6 to 82.94 over Bok-aneers; best possible lineup 133.6 (week-6 archive, recomputed this run).

case.label: The lesson
case.body: Both were projection calls that lost. The fix is not to override — it is to set the lineup every week, which is done for Week 7: the lineup as set is the projection lineup.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: A Week 7 lineup set by projection leaves more than 15 points on the bench (archive).
